reason: The plugin is a cosmetic user-interface skin package for DeepSeek Harness, focused on visual customization through a new skin row, posters, scenes, and overlay pet visuals; it does not describe external integrations, workflow automation, or content/knowledge processing.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 C-137 视觉主题的插件，可切换 28 张海报、场景和 Rick/Morty 叠加宠物等界面元素。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a C-137 visual theme for DeepSeek Harness, adding poster themes, scene visuals, and Rick/Morty overlay pet elements to the interface.

capabilities: Applies a selectable visual skin for DeepSeek Harness with catalog posters and custom scene options.
Adds overlay pet elements and related UI interactions on the shell/home interface.
Writes/reads skin-related settings under the plugin namespace in local settings configuration.

reasons.code: README identifies the plugin as a "C-137 skin" with "28 catalog posters, user-added scenes, neon chrome, and overlay pets."
README lists a Skin row in Settings and host route assets under `/dsh-c137/*`, showing the plugin’s primary effect is interface theming and visual customization.
